topic.title: Git Client Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , enabling you to commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: The Git Client adds a built-in Git client to . After you install the it, you can use the top-level Git menu, three dedicated views, a preferences page, and contextual Git actions in other views and editors.

The following sections will guide you through setting up and working with the Git Client. Install the add-on, configure access, and set up a repository. Then review changes and stage files for a commit, commit changes and push them, pull changes from remote repositories, manage branches, and resolve conflicts. The add-on also uses the comparison and merge tools available in . After the workflow topics, the interface overview and action reference provide lookup information.
The Git Client add-on works with a selected Git working copy. It shows local file changes, staged changes, branch states, and repository history so you can complete common Git tasks without leaving .
